Incident B involved an outdated firewall rule blocking legitimate CI/CD traffic to GitHub on port 8443. No malicious activity was found. Actions taken: binary whitelisted and firewall rule removed to restore operations.

timeline.description: Alert triggered: AV false positive on deploy-agent.exe (INC-2026-1205A).
Alert triggered: Firewall rule blocking CI/CD pipeline (INC-2026-1205B).
Analysis completed: Confirmed both incidents as operational, no threat actor involvement.
Admin action completed: deploy-agent.exe whitelisted; firewall rule 'BLOCK-DEPLOY-EXTERNAL' deleted.
